behavioral.objective: Test behavioral mispricing hypotheses such as favorite-longshot, optimism, attention and flow bias without assuming persistence.

cross_venue.objective: Find economically equivalent payouts across venues only after proving contract identity, settlement compatibility and transfer/collateral reality.

informed_flow.objective: Test whether observable flow patterns contain incremental predictive information without relying on private identity data.

market_algebra.objective: Find formally provable payout identities, dominance relations, collateral/netting anomalies, combo/MVE relations and synthetic equivalents.

microstructure.objective: Test order-book, maker/taker, queue, spread, depth, partial-fill and adverse-selection hypotheses using executable point-in-time data.

new_products.objective: Continuously inspect new venues, products, rule changes and market structures for newly testable edge mechanisms.

settlement_rules.objective: Find informational or structural gaps in settlement rules, source timing, finality, revisions, rounding and fallback behavior.

weather.objective: Predict contract settlement values from point-in-time meteorological state and test whether executable market prices underreact.

promotion_rule: No candidate may advance on narrative plausibility alone; each promotion requires predefined falsifiable evidence.
purpose: General prediction-market edge discovery. Weather is one lane, not the system objective.
